title: Decoding Alignment: A Critical Survey of LLM Development Initiatives through Value-setting and Data-centric Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Critical review of LLM technical documentation on alignment objectives and synthesis of empirical literature showing liberal, Western, and corporate ideological leanings in aligned models.

Evaluation of the cultural 'flattening effect' of corporate alignment paradigms and synthesis of literature demonstrating model alignment with dominant US/Western cultural values over global perspectives.
Reviewing recent empirical studies that audit LLMs for biases in national narratives and historical conflicts, noting a favor toward Western/US perspectives.

Auditing publicly available LLM development reports (e.g., system cards) to assess how tech companies define and prioritize the avoidance of general biases and stereotypes under their 'harmlessness' and safety objectives.
